page_title: BET 0-0 ESP | Betis v Espanyol 04/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Guillermo Cuadra is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Pablo Garcia (Betis) received a precise pass and hammers the ball at goal from close range. Unfortunately for him, his aim was a bit off and it flies just over the bar.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
87' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
84' Substitution. Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) replaces Exposito.
84' Flag up against Jofre (Espanyol). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
81' Exposito (Espanyol) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

80' OFF THE BAR! Pablo Garcia (Betis) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the crossbar! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
79' Chimy Avila (Betis) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
79' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
78' Today's match ends for Cyril Ngonge who will be replaced by Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol).
78' The substitution is prepared. Jofre (Espanyol) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tyrhys Dolan.
76' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Aitor Ruibal (Betis) for a tough tackle.
75' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Pablo Garcia (Betis) replaces Sergi Altimira.
74' Substitution. Hector Bellerin makes way for Chimy Avila (Betis).
74' The attendance is 54444.
70' The foul by Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Guillermo Cuadra.
67' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Guillermo Cuadra lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
66' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
66' The manager makes a subsitution with Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) coming on for Antony.
65' Espanyol can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Guillermo Cuadra ignores the protests.
60' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
58' It is time for a substitution. Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is on for Roberto Fernandez Jaen.
57' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
53' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) is adjudged offside.
51' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
49' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) makes a strong challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.
46' Referee Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Antony (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
42' Rough tackle by Valentin Gomez (Betis). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
39' What a big chance! Cucho Hernandez (Betis) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
38' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.

35' Alvaro Valles pulls off a decent save! Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
34' Antony (Betis) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
34' A quickly taken corner by Betis.

34' Marko Dmitrovic is a nightmare for the offensive players! Sergi Altimira (Betis) meets a cross on the edge of the penalty area, takes a good first touch and fires a rocket of a shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper produces a wonderful save. Betis force their opponents to concede a corner.
31' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Pablo Fornals (Betis) heads on.
30' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Marko Dmitrovic makes a great save.
27' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the right post.
27' Wow, what an escape. Cucho Hernandez (Betis) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
26' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
26' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
23' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
21' Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pablo Fornals (Betis).
18' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is able to continue to play.
16' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
15' Antony (Betis) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

14' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Betis, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
13' A short pass finds Exposito (Espanyol). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
12' Antony (Betis) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
11' Marc Bartra (Betis) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
9' Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul after Aitor Ruibal (Betis) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

7' Diego Llorente (Betis) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the right side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
7' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
7' A cross into the box from Hector Bellerin (Betis) is cleared. It will be a corner kick for Betis.
5' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alvaro Valles intercepts the ball.
4' The Espanyol players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Espanyol will take the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra is the one to supervise the game today.
